## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与最终行为

Describe the use case and change. Link an issue if applicable. / 描述使用场景和改动，可关联 Issue。

## Validation / 验证

List checks actually run and results. Mark device-only behavior as untested when applicable. / 填写实际执行的检查及结果，未进行的实机验证请明确说明。

## Screenshots / 截图

For visible changes, add English/Chinese screenshots where relevant. Remove PINs, credentials, device identifiers and personal content. / 界面改动按需附中英文截图，并先脱敏。

## Review notes / 审查说明

- [ ] Focused change; no unrelated generated projects, frameworks or packages. / 修改范围清楚，未附无关生成文件。
- [ ] User-facing strings and applicable locale/document mappings updated. / 已按需更新词条和语言/文档映射。
- [ ] Third-party sources and notices retained; new dependency terms identified. / 保留第三方来源与声明，新增依赖注明许可。
- [ ] No live credentials, private keys or personal wallpaper packs included. / 未包含真实凭据、私钥或私人壁纸包。
